# The Grand Plan

> The Grand Plan helps people approaching or living in their fourth quarter of life reflect, plan, and pursue renewed purpose through a six-summit process.

This file is a curated guide to public website content. It is not a crawler permission policy. Course enrollment and community access are separate from these informational pages.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.thegrandplan.org/): Overview of The Grand Plan and its approach to fourth-quarter purpose.
- [6-Summit Journey](https://www.thegrandplan.org/6-summit-journey): Learn about the six-summit process.
- [On-Demand Course](https://www.thegrandplan.org/on-demand-course): Information about the on-demand course.
- [Individual Access](https://www.thegrandplan.org/individual-access): Explore getting started as an individual.
- [Groups](https://www.thegrandplan.org/groups): Information for groups exploring The Grand Plan.
- [About](https://www.thegrandplan.org/about): Learn about The Grand Plan.
- [Contact](https://www.thegrandplan.org/contact): Start a conversation with the team.
- [Donate](https://www.thegrandplan.org/donate): Information about supporting The Grand Plan.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.thegrandplan.org/privacy-policy): Website privacy policy.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.thegrandplan.org/terms-of-use): Website terms of use.
